text:
Ava Li: Quick heads-up — scheduling a canary rebuild + RBAC/KMS audit drill at 15:30 PT. Goal: validate audit log flow -> BigQuery, test KMS signing with staging key, and confirm minimal runtime privileges after the rebase.
Marco Perez: SGTM. Which image tags are we cutting for the canary? staging only? :eyes:
Ava Li: Using `base-image:v2026-03-01-canary` and `runtime-layer:compact-canary`. Canary will be limited to staging-1 and the deployer service account.
Devon Singh: Please confirm the preflight RBAC: the builder SA should only have `cloudkms.cryptoKeySign` on the signing key and push perms to the staging repo. No broad project roles.
Ava Li: Correct. I'll push a minimal IAM snippet shortly.
Ava Li: IAM binding we plan to apply (preflight):
```yaml
resource: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/staging/cryptoKeys/canary-key
bindings:
  - role: roles/cloudkms.signer
    members:
      - serviceAccount:image-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Marco Perez: Looks good. I'll run a dry-run of the iam policy set and share the diff.
Priya Rao: On audit logs: are we testing the sink from Cloud Audit -> logging-shipper -> BigQuery? I want to validate the event schema for `cosign` and image-pull metadata.
Ava Li: Yes — expected sink filter: `protoPayload.methodName:"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign" OR resource.type="container"` sending to `projects/redwood/datasets/redwood_audit.staging_images`. We'll verify with a synthetic sign/push.
Devon Singh: Signing command for the drill (use staging key):
```bash
cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/staging/cryptoKeys/canary-key 
  gcr.io/redwood/base-image:v2026-03-01-canary
```
Priya Rao: deploy-bot, can you start the canary once signing is complete?
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for base-image:v2026-03-01-canary in staging-1 (build #4398). Status: provisioning.
Marco Perez: After deploy, I'll tail kube audit logs and confirm KMS sign calls show up in the sink.
Ava Li: Also test the RBAC denial path: the old `image-pusher@infra` account should be denied signing. Try to run cosign with that SA to validate fail-case.
Devon Singh: Will run the negative test. Also adding `kubectl` to force a rollout for the canary controller:
```bash
kubectl -n staging rollout restart deployment/canary-runtime-controller --context=staging-1
```
Marco Perez: Saw an alert — during the canary build the scanner flagged a glibc advisory. CVE-2026-1111 referenced in the image layer.
Ava Li: This is part of the drill — treat it as a real triage. Quick triage notes: severity = medium, exploitability = limited, mitigations available (backport patch).
Priya Rao: Steps: 1) pause canary, 2) capture image snapshot and SBOM, 3) notify vuln team and mark in tracker, 4) decide patch vs revert.
Devon Singh: Pausing canary now. `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deployment/canary-runtime-controller -n staging`
Marco Perez: Snapshotting image blob and SBOM to `gs://redwood-artifacts/canary-snapshots/4398/`.
Ava Li: For the audit trail, ensure we annotate the incident with the KMS sign transaction id and the cosign output. e.g. add annotation: `reprovision.kms.signature: <signature-id>` so it surfaces in BigQuery.
Priya Rao: I've opened an internal incident page: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-03-canary-dryrun-4398 — added initial notes and assigned @Marco Perez for artifact collection and @Devon Singh for the rebuild.
Marco Perez: Quick fix plan: rebuild base-image with patched glibc, bump tag to `v2026-03-01-canary-patch`, re-sign with the same staging key, and re-run canary in staging-1.
Devon Singh: ETA for rebuild ~ 45m. Will run local CI with the scanner and SBOM diff.
Ava Li: Post-drill checklist: 1) confirm KMS sign events in BigQuery, 2) verify RBAC negative tests logged as denied, 3) ensure cosign signatures are stored in artifact registry, 4) update runbook with observed gaps.
Priya Rao: Also add one more validation: verify audit retention policy picks up the `accessPayload` fields from KMS calls for 90 days.
Marco Perez: Noted. I'll follow up with a quick query we can run: `SELECT * FROM redwood_audit.staging_images WHERE protoPayload.methodName LIKE "%AsymmetricSign%" ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50;`
Ava Li: Thanks everyone — if anyone finds anything unexpected, @me and we'll escalate to incident channel. Otherwise we'll debrief in 30m post-cleanup. :white_check_mark:
